name: copywriting-kit
description: Conversion copywriting for your own small-business or SaaS website: edit, diagnose and rewrite SaaS landing page copy, a sales page, homepage headline, pricing or about page. Edited text first with every number, name and claim kept, a plain diagnosis of what is broken (positioning, value proposition or messaging) before any rewrite, claims checked against your evidence, page drafts from your facts, and a brand voice guide from your own writing. Proof, testimonials and urgency are never invented.
